standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The top edge and metal foot show restrained eased highlights while preserving the original C-table profile.

rear.note: Twin rear supports remain attached to the top and base without a new gap.

detail.note: Close framing shows a softly finished top edge and connected uprights; the plain white top remains intentional.

underside.note: Both underside attachment points and the closed base plate are visible.

clay.note: The simple cantilever construction remains coherent without materials; improvement is modest edge and surface refinement.

front.note: The linen cabinet retains its clean inset door, pull and recessed toe plinth with softer edge highlights.

rear.note: Closed rear panel and small original rear fitting remain aligned.

detail.note: Door border and narrow handle remain separate and legible; the finish is intentionally plain.

underside.note: Closed base and recessed plinth have no missing panel or unsupported corner.

clay.note: Material-free view confirms the inset door and eased cabinet construction remain readable.

front.note: Three graduated wax pillars are recognizable, but their glowing tops are blunt cylinders rather than flame silhouettes.

rear.note: Rear view confirms the same flat-ended luminous posts on all three candles.

detail.note: Full detail makes the cylindrical flame proxies obvious; each needs a bounded tapered flame form preserving its emission material.

underside.note: All three wax bottoms are closed and the candle bodies remain sound.

clay.note: The uncolored silhouettes retain the blunt top posts, so a surface-only refinement does not resolve the weak flame construction.

front.note: The blue cabinet has cleaner eased edges, a framed ribbed door and a distinct recessed base.

rear.note: Rear panel and top overhang remain complete and aligned.

detail.note: Vertical ribs and the long pull are individually readable; this inherited door is ribbed, not newly woven cane.

underside.note: Closed underside and dark plinth support the cabinet without new gaps.

clay.note: Ribbed door relief remains visible without color; the plain carcass and inherited cane-name mismatch are limitations.

front.note: The long media cabinet retains three separated ribbed fronts with softened top and side edges.

rear.note: Full-width rear and original small cable fitting remain intact.

detail.note: Door grooves and narrow pulls remain clear; the existing rib pattern is not a claim of realistic cane weaving.

underside.note: The long recessed plinth and closed underside read as one supported case.

clay.note: Three front panels and their relief survive the clay view; surface improvement remains restrained.

front.note: The bed has softer pillows and cover edges inside its original slender connected canopy frame.

rear.note: Footboard, mattress stack and four posts remain aligned from behind.

detail.note: Full detail shows pillow edging lying on the covers and connected canopy corners; the striped coverlet remains simple.

underside.note: The closed foundation and legs retain a coherent supported mattress stack.

clay.note: Pillow loft and softened bed edges are visible without color; this remains a simple modern canopy design.

front.note: The connected chrome frame and softer seat improve the chair, but the dark seat piping breaks across the front.

rear.note: Back mounts and continuous cantilever runners remain connected.

detail.note: Full detail shows interrupted piping ends emerging from the seat corners instead of a continuous seated seam.

underside.note: The closed seat pan and runners remain complete and aligned.

clay.note: The lofted cushion is readable, but the uneven perimeter line needs a source-specific seating repair.

front.note: The chrome sling frame and arm pads remain clear, but the cushion perimeter has wavy, broken dark piping.

rear.note: Rear frame, arm mounts and back support remain attached without a silhouette regression.

detail.note: Full detail confirms the front-corner seam turns into exposed irregular wire-like segments and disappears across the front.

underside.note: The seat underside, cantilever runners and arm supports remain structurally coherent.

clay.note: The main upholstery improvement is visible in clay, but the perimeter seam still needs continuous contact.

front.note: Layered cast columns, recessed firebrick and authored flames remain clearly distinct.

rear.note: The closed firebox rear and stepped iron frame remain intact.

detail.note: Fluted columns, brass ornaments, brick courses and round logs retain readable depth; flames remain intentionally stylized.

underside.note: The grate and firebox opening remain clear from below without missing casework.

clay.note: The detailed iron and masonry construction survives without color; the refinement preserves the accepted fireplace character.

front.note: Softened platform edges and the staggered tower silhouette remain readable at application scale.

rear.note: The tall post and lower enclosure remain connected to the original base.

detail.note: Platform-to-post contact is sound; the monochrome surfaces remain simple rather than a claim of detailed scratching rope.

underside.note: Closed platforms and base are present, including the original two dark underside fittings.

clay.note: Three usable levels and the lower opening remain clear in the uncolored view.

front.note: The sagging slat bridge and two supported landings retain a recognizable wall-mounted construction.

rear.note: Opposite view preserves the same connected rails, posts and support brackets.

detail.note: Individual slats follow the curve with visible thickness and restrained warm timber detail.

underside.note: The paired bracket supports and continuous bridge underside remain coherent.

clay.note: The curved bridge construction is visible in clay; it is not merely a material change.

front.note: Four distinct timber paddles connect to the layered motor housing with restrained surface detail.

rear.note: Blade arrangement and centered housing remain consistent from the opposite side.

detail.note: Motor collars and clipped paddle corners are clear; the angular paddle outline is an intentional simple blade design.

underside.note: The centered warm diffuser and blade-root connections remain visible from below.

clay.note: Layered motor, blades and ceiling attachment remain readable without materials.

front.note: The round case has smoother edge highlights and a separate diffuser band.

rear.note: The rear mounting button and circular cover remain centered.

detail.note: Fine brass surface response and the layered rim improve the previously coarse case while retaining its dimensions.

underside.note: The broad opal diffuser sits inside a clear retaining ring with no missing bottom.

clay.note: Layered circular construction remains evident without color.

front.note: The oval top and pedestal are recognizable, but the broad base still has conspicuous polygonal steps.

rear.note: The opposite silhouette retains the same angular radial base and rim.

detail.note: Full detail confirms coarse facets on the foot and oval edge; the turned profile needs denser radial construction within its bounds.

underside.note: The pedestal remains attached to a closed top and foot, with no missing underside.

clay.note: Clay exposes the angular foot silhouette clearly, so improved shading alone is insufficient.

front.note: The compact sleeper has visibly softer seat and back covers while retaining its distinct arms and pull-out base.

rear.note: Rear upholstery panels remain closed and aligned with the arm structure.

detail.note: Fine cloth texture and tailored seat edging improve the formerly blockier covers; the pull handle remains legible.

underside.note: Legs, base panel and small mechanism fittings remain attached.

clay.note: Lofted cushions and separate arm panels remain clear without color.

front.note: Three mattress sections extend cleanly from the chair on their authored support frame.

rear.note: The chair back and extended bed remain connected and aligned.

detail.note: Softened mattress boxing and subtle cloth grain improve the flat source pads without changing the fold layout.

underside.note: The extended metal supports and closed panels remain visible beneath the bed.

clay.note: The separated mattress sections and supporting frame read clearly in clay.

front.note: The segmented luminous ring hangs evenly from its original three wires and ceiling cap.

rear.note: The rear view preserves the same circular suspension and regular stone segments.

detail.note: Individual light segments, separators and brass ring edges remain clear with restrained highlights.

underside.note: The open ring center and lower supports are visible without an unintended filled disc.

clay.note: Segmented construction and suspension remain legible without materials.

front.note: Three nested light tiers and surrounding pendants retain a coherent chandelier silhouette.

rear.note: Central support and ceiling cap remain aligned through the tiers.

detail.note: Rings, luminous discs and separate crystal drops are clear; the discs are retained authored diffuser surfaces.

underside.note: The tiered undersides and hanging drops remain complete from below.

clay.note: The stepped chandelier construction survives in clay; simplified crystals are an acceptable application-scale limitation.

front.note: Six opal globes on staggered brass branches remain distinct and connected.

rear.note: Opposite view confirms the branch junctions and central stem are intact.

detail.note: Rounded globes, small caps and angular brass arms have clear material separation and smoother highlights.

underside.note: All globes remain attached to their branch ends from below.

clay.note: Branch hierarchy and varied globe heights remain readable without color.

front.note: Three seat and back covers have visible tailored loft while preserving the low green sofa profile.

rear.note: Rear rail and cushions remain supported and continuous across the sofa.

detail.note: Subtle grain and restrained upholstery puckering replace the flatter source pads without coarse basket weave.

underside.note: The closed base and four metal legs remain attached.

clay.note: Separate cushion boxing and softer profiles are clear in clay; the low arms remain simple.

front.note: The channel headboard and layered bed retain their proportions with softer pillows and cover edges.

rear.note: Footboard and mattress layers stay aligned with the original frame.

detail.note: Pillow loops sit on their covers; the narrow coverlet channels and headboard ribs remain distinct.

underside.note: The bed foundation stays closed with its original supports and layered mattress edge.

clay.note: The softened bedding reads without color; plain frame panels remain an inherited limitation.

front.note: The alternating squares still read as separate hard tiles rather than one textile rug.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats wide recessed grid lines and rectangular slab fringe pieces.

detail.note: Full detail shows individually beveled plates and brick-like fringes; a continuous textile surface and shaped yarn fringes are needed.

underside.note: The backing is closed and continuous, so the problem is the upper construction rather than a missing base.

clay.note: The tile grid remains obvious in clay and is not resolved by the fine surface texture.

front.note: Warm upholstery, a timber platform and three lofted seat cushions retain a distinct sofa construction.

rear.note: Closed rear upholstery and platform stay aligned with the separate arm panels.

detail.note: Full detail shows connected tuft buttons, restrained cloth folds and visible timber grain; the tufting remains stylized rather than deeply recessed.

underside.note: Four timber legs and the closed platform remain structurally coherent.

clay.note: Seat loft, separate arms and shallow button pattern remain readable without materials.

front.note: The flared hood and tall chimney retain clean eased edges and a distinct front grille.

rear.note: The rear case remains complete with no open or unsupported panel.

detail.note: Narrow grille slats and three small controls remain readable against the plain light housing.

underside.note: The underside extraction slots are visible and separated from the front grille.

clay.note: Flared construction and separate chimney remain clear in clay.

front.note: The machined case, tilted display ring and top controls remain legible with finer metal response.

rear.note: Rear connector rows and the raised display housing remain intact.

detail.note: The display text stays readable, while the recessed screen, knobs and ventilation detail are preserved.

underside.note: Four feet, screws and the closed base remain attached.

clay.note: Recessed display geometry and layered case detail remain evident without materials.

front.note: Dense individual needle shoots, colored bulbs and a small woven pot preserve the accepted slim tree silhouette.

rear.note: Rear crown remains filled and irregular rather than a stack of cones.

detail.note: Full detail retains branching needles and distinct bulb colors; the refinement is restrained because the original tree was already detailed.

underside.note: The pot has a closed bottom and the lower branch structure remains present.

clay.note: Needle and shoot structure remains dense without color; this does not claim new animation validation.

front.note: The full lit tree retains dense needle foliage, varied bulb colors and its original pot.

rear.note: The opposite side keeps branching depth and an uneven botanical outline.

detail.note: Individual shoots and bulbs stay distinct with subdued surface refinement rather than a simplified foliage replacement.

underside.note: The pot base and lower branches remain complete from below.

clay.note: The detailed branching silhouette survives in clay; its close similarity to the smaller tree is inherited.

front.note: The light top and metal foot retain a clean C-table silhouette with improved edge response.

rear.note: Twin uprights remain seated between the top and base plate.

detail.note: The simple white top has a restrained eased edge; polished supports remain readable.

underside.note: Closed underside plates and both attachment points remain intact.

clay.note: The cantilever structure reads coherently in clay; improvement is modest and the shared design is inherited.

front.note: The lever press has a clear upright, top cup, ridged juicing cone and catch bowl.

rear.note: Rear column and lever supports remain connected to the weighted base.

detail.note: Separate cone ribs and the recessed bowl remain readable under the refined metal response.

underside.note: Catch bowl, drain spout and base remain complete and attached.

clay.note: The mechanical press construction stays recognizable without materials.

front.note: The oval tub retains a recessed basin and four distinct raised feet with smoother surface response.

rear.note: Opposite view preserves the faucet and continuous outer shell.

detail.note: The basin lip and inset interior are clearly separate; the small faucet remains simple.

underside.note: Closed tub bottom and all four original feet remain present.

clay.note: The real basin recess reads in clay; the inherited block-like feet are stylized rather than ornate carved claws.

front.note: Raised hands, readable numerals and a marble dial remain clear inside the brass case.

rear.note: The closed rear case and small support stem remain aligned with the foot.

detail.note: Dial markings, marble veining and layered bezel stay readable with restrained metal grain.

underside.note: The stem and solid foot remain attached below the clock.

clay.note: Layered face, hands and numeral geometry survive in clay.

front.note: The radial metal rays and layered clock face retain a clear sunburst silhouette.

rear.note: The closed rear case joins the alternating long and short rays consistently.

detail.note: Full detail preserves all raised numerals and hands, but their inherited dark-on-dark contrast remains limited; brass ticks stay legible.

underside.note: Low view confirms rays and case depth without missing supports or an open rear.

clay.note: Raised dial geometry and staggered rays remain clear without color; approval does not claim the dark numeral contrast was solved.

front.note: The tall case retains its six separated fronts, narrow handles and eased panel edges.

rear.note: The closed rear panel and small fitting remain unchanged in position.

detail.note: Door gaps and fine edge bevels are readable; the rectangular inherited case is not newly converted into an L-shaped corner unit.

underside.note: The dark recessed plinth and closed underside remain complete.

clay.note: Door layout and supported case remain coherent in clay with modest construction refinement.

front.note: The open closet retains its paired cubby columns and small original top rail with softer shelf edges.

rear.note: The full rear panel and side case remain aligned.

detail.note: Full detail confirms attached shelves and a top rod; the shallow hanging bay and mostly cubby-based layout are inherited limitations.

underside.note: Shelf undersides and the recessed base remain closed and supported.

clay.note: The storage partitions remain clear in clay; no improved garment clearance is claimed.

front.note: The narrow open module retains four shelf openings and restrained eased case edges.

rear.note: Its rear panel and small original fitting remain complete.

detail.note: Shelf-to-side connections are clean, with fine edge highlights rather than razor-sharp plates.

underside.note: Shelf undersides and dark base are intact with no visible unsupported section.

clay.note: The open storage layout remains coherent without materials.

front.note: The shaped shoulder rail, projecting trouser bar and lower tray retain a recognizable clothes-valet silhouette.

rear.note: Twin upright posts and angled hanger profile stay connected from behind.

detail.note: Small side pegs and rail joints remain distinct with restrained timber surface detail.

underside.note: The tray base and two wide feet remain attached and closed.

clay.note: The hanger, projecting bar and tray remain legible in clay; the thin original structure is preserved.
